rule.signal: Form 4/5 non-derivative transaction code P (open-market or private purchase) of common equity / ADR
rule.entry: regular-session open of the first trading day strictly after the SEC filing date
rule.exit: none — positions stay open for forward testing
rule.size: fixed $10,000 notional per insider-buy filing (fractional shares)
rule.lookahead: none — filing-day prices are never used as the fill
rule.costs: none modelled (no commission, no bid/ask beyond using the next open)
rule.prices: Yahoo Finance daily bars, Stooq fallback, Nasdaq historical fallback
